buff.desperado.name: Desperado

buff.critStrike.name: Critical Strike

buff.faultLine.name: Fault Line

curse.snack.name: Snack
curse.snack.desc: Enemies heal when they damage you.
curse.allOrNothing.name: Double or Nothing
curse.allOrNothing.desc: All damage sources are either doubled or do no damage.
curse.metabolism.name: Metabolism
curse.metabolism.desc: Status effects last half as long for enemies.
curse.badPosture.name: Bad Posture
curse.badPosture.desc: You are knocked further back when hitting an enemy.
curse.restraints.name: Restraints
curse.restraints.desc: A bloody chain pulls you to the ground.
curse.iceyBlood.name: Icy Blood
curse.iceyBlood.desc: Enemies form a protective layer of ice if they aren't damaged for longer than 7 seconds.
curse.ruptured.name: Ruptured
curse.coagulation.name: Coagulation
curse.coagulation.desc: Pulling blood outside of combat causes phlegm to congeal from the pools left behind.
curse.parasitized.name: Parasitic
curse.parasitized.desc: Fiends have a 33% chance to sprout tendrils when killed that chase you.
curse.rottenBreath.name: Rotten Breath
curse.rottenBreath.desc: When a brute screams it leaves a toxic zone that deals damage.
curse.beastsRoar.name: Beast's Roar
curse.beastsRoar.desc: When a brute roars, all fiends fly into a [RAGE]rage[RESET].
curse.adrenaline.name: Wounded War Cry
curse.adrenaline.desc: When a brute is slain it lets out a final roar, clinging to life for 5 seconds before it truly dies.
curse.provoked.name: Provoked
curse.revenge.name: Revenge
curse.revenge.desc: When a brute is the last enemy standing, it flies into a [RAGE]rage[RESET].
curse.proudFlesh.name: Proud Flesh
curse.proudFlesh.desc: Healing past your max health deals 5 damage per pip overhealed.
curse.discharge.name: Discharge
curse.discharge.desc: After recovering from being [STUN]stunned[RESET], enemies release a shockwave that [STUN]stuns[RESET] you.
curse.infestation.name: Infestation
curse.infestation.desc: Enemies have a chance to release rotflys when taking damage.
curse.privilege.name: Tyrant's Privilege
curse.privilege.desc: Brutes siphon health from enemies when critical.
curse.lastBreath.name: Final Breath
curse.lastBreath.desc: Each time an enemy is killed, all remaining enemies gain 10 damage.
curse.filthyGlare.name: Filthy Glare
curse.filthyGlare.desc: A zone closes around a marked enemy, getting hit while outside it inflicts [BLEED]bleed[RESET].
curse.symbiotic.name: Symbiotic
curse.symbiotic.desc: Brutes release parasitic tendrils when [STUN]stunned[RESET] or killed.
curse.reversal.name: Reversal
curse.reversal.desc: Getting hit by a stunnable enemy passes it's [STUN]stun[RESET] to you.
curse.mobTactics.name: Mob Tactics
curse.mobTactics.desc: 10% chance each room has no brutes. Fiends and vermin spawn twice.
curse.thorns.name: Thorns
curse.thorns.desc: Enemy contact damage is doubled and inflicts [BLEED]bleed[RESET].
curse.tunnelVision.name: Tunnel Vision
curse.tunnelVision.desc: Enemies outside your line of sight are invisible.
curse.omission.name: Omission
curse.omission.desc: All future curses are hidden until claimed.
curse.omitted.name: Omitted

trinket.sabatons.name: Heavy Sabatons
trinket.sabatons.desc: Falling from heights causes a quake that deals more damage and pushes enemies further away the higher you fell from.
trinket.unbreakable.name: Bones Unbreakable
trinket.unbreakable.desc: You cannot die while more than 2 [SCAR]pips[RESET] remain.
trinket.scissors.name: Broken Scissors
trinket.scissors.desc: Sword attacks have a 25% chance to deal 75% damage twice.
trinket.bloodHelm.name: Blood Iron Helmet
trinket.bloodHelm.desc: Healing fully while in combat gives you 1 [ARMOR]armor[RESET].
trinket.serrated.name: Serrated Fracture
trinket.ectoplasm.name: Ectoplasm
trinket.ectoplasm.desc: All future offerings are now double their value, but you receive 2 random curses.
trinket.contamination.name: Contamination
trinket.contamination.desc: Side Arms that touch the ground now deal [POISON]poison[RESET].
trinket.furyLamp.name: Fury Lantern

trinket.fistOfFear.name: Fist of Fear

trinket.hemangioma.name: Hemangioma
trinket.hemangioma.desc: A tumor that periodically bursts, flinging a ring of eyes that damage enemies and pop into blood.
trinket.hematoma.name: Hematoma
trinket.hematoma.desc: A tumor that grows over time. When you're hit, it bursts into blood and bones that damage enemies.
trinket.fingers.name: Twitchy Fingers
trinket.fingers.desc: Getting hit increases your attack speed by 150% for 2 seconds
trinket.recover.name: Recover
trinket.recover.desc: Killing an enemy heals all damage and [SCAR]scars[RESET] it has inflicted on you in the past 10 seconds.
trinket.forgeScraps.name: Forge Scraps
trinket.armorPolish.name: Cage Polish
trinket.armorPolish.desc: Armor has a 25% chance to block damage without breaking.
trinket.shatteredCleaver.name: Shattered Cleaver
trinket.shatteredCleaver.desc: Heavy attacking releases 3 shards for every broken armor. Armor breaking doesn't interrupt your heavy attack charge.
trinket.spearhead.name: Spearhead
trinket.spearhead.desc: Your melee attacks have a 15% chance to pierce enemy armor and inflict [BLEED]bleed[RESET].
trinket.pokeKey.name: Poke Key
trinket.pokeKey.desc: You can unlock things without keys but doing so deals 5 damage 2-5 times
trinket.concealedCleaver.name: Concealed Cleaver
trinket.concealedCleaver.desc: Heavy attacks charge up 5% quicker per 10 damage in your combo.
trinket.thoughtCrime.name: Imaginary Sword
trinket.thoughtCrime.desc: When you hit an enemy, 20% chance to hit a random additional enemy.
trinket.thoughtCrime.flavor: "I thought of it in my mind."
trinket.pummelPommel.name: Pummel Pommel
trinket.pummelPommel.desc: The first sword hit on a [STUN]stunned[RESET] enemy reapplies [STUN]stun[RESET].
trinket.pouch.name: Encumbered Pouch
trinket.pouch.desc: You can collect up to 3 [ARMOR]armor[RESET] past your max, but every piece of armor reduces your speed.
trinket.craftedSword.name: Crafted Sword
trinket.craftedSword.desc: Hitting enemies while falling deals 50% bonus damage.
trinket.flintBlade.name: Flint Blade
trinket.flintBlade.desc: Sword attacks that parry or hit armor inflicts [BURN]ember[RESET]
trinket.petRock.name: Pet Rock
trinket.selfSharpening.name: Self Sharpening Blade

trinket.fervorMax.name: Fervorous Gaze
trinket.fervorMax.flavor: " I've never seen fear turn to rage so quickly"

trinket.ramsHead.name: Ram's Head
trinket.brassKnuckles.name: Gadling Rings

trinket.knuckleTape.name: Knuckle Wraps
trinket.knuckleTape.desc: Attacks deal 8 bonus damage to [STUN]stunned[RESET] enemies.
trinket.ferrocerium.name: Ferrocerium
trinket.ferrocerium.desc: Hitting an enemy with [BURN]burn[RESET] has a 30% chance to kindle [BURN]burn[RESET] to nearby enemies.
trinket.lastDrops.name: Last Drops
trinket.lastDrops.desc: Absorbing pulls blood from critical enemies, dealing 3 damage per blood drop pulled.
trinket.avarice.name: Avarice
trinket.avarice.desc: Pick 2 offerings instead of 1, but each offering's purity is halved.
trinket.ironLedger.name: Iron Ledger
trinket.ironLedger.desc: Every 5 kills without taking damage, gain 1 [ARMOR]armor[RESET].
trinket.severedFang.name: Severed Fang
trinket.severedFang.desc: Killing a [POISON]poisoned[RESET] enemy with a side arm releases a venom burst, [POISON]poisoning[RESET] all nearby enemies.
trinket.ritualIncense.name: Ritual Incense
trinket.ritualIncense.desc: All enemies enter the room already [BURN]burning[RESET].
trinket.pusBurst.name: Pus Burst
trinket.pusBurst.desc: Enemies that die burst into pus globs, damaging enemies they land on.
trinket.crescentDagger.name: Crescent Dagger
trinket.crescentDagger.desc: Hitting multiple enemies with a single swing deals 5 extra damage to each for every other enemy hit.
trinket.marksmanInsignia.name: Marksman Insignia
trinket.marksmanInsignia.desc: Based on distance travelled, sidearms deal up to 400% damage if it would kill an enemy.
trinket.skewer.name: Skewer
trinket.skewer.desc: Your projectiles deal 10% damage for each enemy they've already hit.
trinket.remnantEdge.name: Remnant Edge
trinket.remnantEdge.desc: When your side arm is destroyed, gain 4 damage per hit for the rest of the room. Stacks up to 3 times.
trinket.remnantEdge.flavor: Still hurts when I hit you, doesn't it?
trinket.weepingMarrow.name: Weeping Marrow
trinket.weepingMarrow.desc: Hitting [CRIT]critical[RESET] or [BLEED]bleeding[RESET] enemies slightly fills your blood bar.
trinket.hollowFang.name: Fang Necklace
trinket.hollowFang.desc: While your combo is above 100 damage, dashing through enemies inflicts [BLEED]bleed[RESET].
trinket.vileCoat.name: Vile Coat
trinket.vileCoat.desc: 30% chance to apply [BLEED]bleed[RESET] when hitting a [POISON]poisoned[RESET] enemy.
trinket.tungstenCore.name: Tungsten Core
trinket.gloriousGore.name: Glorious Gore
trinket.gloriousGore.desc: Airborne gore and debris deal 1 damage to enemy.
trinket.leadMace.name: Lead Mace
trinket.leadMace.desc: Parrying a melee attack with a [HEAVY]heavy slash[RESET] makes the enemy [STUN]stunnable[RESET].
trinket.staggeringStrength.name: Staggering Strength
trinket.staggeringStrength.desc: When you [STUN]stun[RESET] an enemy gain +20% [HEAVY]heavy slash[RESET] damage up to +100%. Resets if you fail to [HEAVY]heavy slash[RESET] a [STUN]stunned[RESET] enemy.
trinket.studdedPauldron.name: Studded Pauldron
trinket.studdedPauldron.desc: Exiting a dash in an enemy pushes it away.
trinket.mortalFear.name: Mortal Fear
trinket.cheapShot.name: Cheap Shot
trinket.cheapShot.desc: [STUN]Stunned[RESET] enemies take 300% damage, but [STUN]stun[RESET] expires on hit.
trinket.hiddenTreasure.name: Hidden Treasure
trinket.hiddenTreasure.desc: Chests hold 3 items, but reward rooms have a 50% chance to be hidden from the map.
trinket.victorySalute.name: Victory Salute
trinket.victorySalute.desc: Enemies have a 50% chance to release fireworks on death that kindle [BURN]burn[RESET] and deal 5 damage.
trinket.divineAppeasement.name: Divine Appeasement
trinket.divineAppeasement.desc: Your damage is reduced by 10%, but all offerings have their grade increased by 1.
trinket.protein.name: Protein
trinket.protein.desc: Deal 10% more damage. You take 10% less damage.
trinket.incandescentGrip.name: Incandescent Grip
trinket.incandescentGrip.desc: Heavy swings spend one fervor charge to fully [BURN]ignite[RESET] anything they hit.
trinket.superheated.name: Superheated
trinket.superheated.desc: [BURN]Ember[RESET] and [BURN]burn[RESET] last twice as long and deal twice as much damage when applied to an [ARMOR]armored[RESET] enemy.
trinket.beautifulMind.name: Beautiful Mind
trinket.beautifulMind.desc: Brutes have a 50% chance to drop a brain. Every 3 brains grants +2 damage for the level.
trinket.dentedHelmet.name: Dented Helmet
trinket.dentedHelmet.desc: [HEAVY]Heavy attacks[RESET] cause enemies to build [STUN]stun[RESET] twice as fast for 2 seconds.
trinket.painPact.name: Pain Pact
trinket.painPact.desc: Damage taken is dealt twice over to the highest health enemy.
trinket.goldenCodpiece.name: Golden Codpiece
trinket.goldenCodpiece.desc: 20% chance to ignore a hit, but you take 10% more damage.
trinket.healthyPlatter.name: Healthy Platter
trinket.moodRing.name: Mood Ring
trinket.moodRing.desc: In combat, deal 5% more damage. Below half health, take 10% less damage. Out of combat, move 15% faster.
trinket.looseSuture.name: Loose Suture
trinket.looseSuture.desc: Critical or bleeding enemies drop extra blood when hit and when they die.
trinket.refortify.name: Refortify
trinket.refortify.desc: After your armor breaks, take 5% less damage for 3 rooms.
trinket.teabag.name: Teabag
trinket.teabag.desc: Rapidly crouching [RAGE]enrages[RESET] the nearest enemy. Deal 50% more damage to [RAGE]enraged[RESET] enemies.
trinket.martyr.name: Martyr
trinket.martyr.desc: Grow a tumor that detaches when you are hurt, all enemies target it for 8 seconds and take damage in it's range.
trinket.elementOfSurprise.name: Element of Surprise
trinket.elementOfSurprise.desc: Enemies start each room already 25% of the way to being [STUN]stunnable[RESET].
trinket.pallbearerCoin.name: Pallbearer's Coin
trinket.pallbearerCoin.desc: The first kill in each room fills the first segment of your blood bar.
trinket.vitality.name: Vitality
trinket.vitality.desc: Every kill fills half a segment of your blood bar until you are hit.
dialogue.raven.intro: Not alive, yet not a shambler. How peculiar...
But that odor. A deep concentration of ichor.
You may make a trade with him.
These trinkets are nothing compared to the glory of the Patron's ichor.
dialogue.raven.chatter1: He feels rage and resentment under the cage.
Are you too trapped by another?
dialogue.patron.explain: Ahhhh... A part of me has returned...
In exchange for returning me my Ichor I shall grant you one of these offerings as compensation.
But... There is a price... There is always a price in exchange for power.
The more ichor you return to me, the stronger the power I offer you...
But there is always a price.
dialogue.patron.return.gravepit: May my power serve you well...
Return to the Squalor and seek out more of my ichor...
dialogue.patron.return.squalor: May my power serve you well...
Return to the Squalor and seek out more of my ichor...
dialogue.patron.gravepit1: So many thrown in, seeking my favor.
So many left to rot instead.
dialogue.patron.gravepit2: Another pit, another mountain of waste.
None of them worth the ichor they carried.
dialogue.patron.gravepit3: Not one of them deserve attention.
dialogue.patron.squalor1: Fear stripped away everything else they were.
dialogue.patron.squalor2: Hear them scuttling in the muck?
Fear made them worms, and worms they shall stay.
dialogue.patron.squalor3: Bottom of the pile, all of them.
Even my ichor couldn't make something of that filth.
dialogue.tutorial.start: Free my ichor from the impure vessels by pressing [getAttack].
Dashing is vital to staying alive, use [getDash] to dash.
dialogue.tutorial.heavy: Mindless swinging isn't always the answer.
Sometimes a more decisive blow is needed.
Holding [getAttack] will begin winding up a heavy attack.
dialogue.tutorial.end: As you attack more and more, your fervor burns.
Once your heart is brimming with fervor, press [getAltAttack], to release your sidearm!
dialogue.tutorial.go: This pit is engorged with my ichor.
Piles of failed vessels litter the ground.
Free my ichor from the impure vessels by pressing [getAttack].
dialogue.tutorial.dash: For a walking husk, you move with surprising speed.
Use [getDash] to dash, allowing you to avoid incoming attacks and make greater distances.
dialogue.tutorial.heavy.intro: Some foes are armored by their own flesh.
Each individual attack builds [STUN]stun[RESET] on enemies.
Strike rapidly with [getAttack] until their guard cracks.
dialogue.tutorial.heavy.stun: Mindless swinging isn't always the answer.
Holding [getAttack] will begin winding up a heavy attack.
Release it to bring them down, Warlock!
dialogue.tutorial.blood: I will allow you to cheat your mortal afflictions.
Hold [getHeal] to pull the blood in and release to heal.
Your blade is as thirsty as I.
Fill a segment of your blade completely to receive healing.
dialogue.tutorial.post_heal: Do not be greedy, for this blood does not belong to you. This is a privilege.
Every drop of blood is one I do not recieve, only use what you need.
Repeated hits wear your body down.
First you are wounded, then you are [SCAR]scarred[RESET].
When you are [SCAR]scarred[RESET], your maximum health is decreased.
Scavenge for [SCAR]tonics[RESET] to mend your wounds.
dialogue.salesman.roomEnter: See my collection, I'm willing to part with it for the right [shake][cRED]price[/shake][RESET].
dialogue.salesman.firstEnter: You've nothing I want, save for that [cRED][shake]ichor[/shake][RESET] running through you.
[cRED]Grades[RESET] are the only currency I deal in. Trade it, and I'll part with a piece of my collection.
Sidearms, secondary tools to complement your blade. Come, come, let me add to your collection.
dialogue.salesman.purchase: A wonderful choice. Hee hee don't let it go to waste!
dialogue.salesman.first_sidearm: Ah.. your first! What an honor, to share a piece of my collection.
That's a sidearm. A secondary tool for you to carry alongside your blade.
It feeds on fervor, land hits with your blade to build it up.
Every piece in my collection has its purpose. Learn yours, or it'll cost you.
